The one crawling with vulture droids.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|audio=DeadAhead-ROTS.flac|}} The '''''Invisible Hand''''' was a modified [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] and one of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagships]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The vessel was colored a light blue-gray, with subtle yellow bow stripes which distinguished it from other ''Providence''-class vessels. As the command ship of the [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]], it also served as the flagship for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. At the height of the Clone Wars in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], it had become one of the most feared ships in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It also was the sister-ship of the ''[[Colicoid Swarm]]'' and the [[Lucid Voice/Legends|''Lucid Voice'']]. ==Specifications and weapons== {{Quote|Activate ray shields!|Grievous activates the ray shields in [[Hallway 328/Legends|Hallway 328]]|audio=ActivateRayShields.flac|}} The ''Invisible Hand'' was manufactured by [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] exiles from the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] world of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] as part of the [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps/Legends|Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]] along with [[Pammant Docks/Legends|Pammant Docks]] at an underground factory on [[Pammant/Legends|Pammant]]. [[File:Boarding_battle.png|thumb|left|The [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] of the ''Invisible Hand''.]] While lacking the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]{{'s}} sheer firepower and armor, the ship was covered with powerful weapon emplacements, including quad [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] turrets, dual [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], point-defense ion cannons, [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] tubes and [[Flak/Legends|flak]] [[Flak gun/Legends|cannons]]. Each shot from the point-defense ion cannons released as much heat as a 4.8 megaton bomb, while the maximum yield of one of the quad turbolasers was equivalent to a magnitude 10 [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]]. As Grievous's replacement flagship, the ''Invisible Hand'' was given several major modifications. The aft reactor bay assembly was rearranged to provide more hangar space, so that the ''Invisible Hand'' could better serve as a carrier and invasion craft. The ship's dorsal fin mounted communication and sensor pod was refitted into spacious quarters, which were eventually taken over by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. From there, Dooku broadcast manipulative propaganda for the Separatist cause. It was known as the [[Wizard's Tower/Legends|Wizard's Tower]], and contained the [[General's quarters]]. ==History== {{Quote|Another happy landing.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|audio=HappyLanding.flac|}}
[[File:InvisibleHandROTS.png|thumb|left|220px|The beginning of the ''Invisible Hand''{{'s}} descent.]]
As the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] became increasingly hostile, they bolstered their fleet with combat starships to further their [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-influenced goals. [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] chose the ''Invisible Hand'' as his flagship. When the Trade Federation joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems, they diverted their heavy ''Providence''-class starships to the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]], including the ''Invisible Hand''. Since control of the Separatist forces was handed to Grievous, after he "lost" the ''Malevolence'', Gunray reluctantly surrendered the ''Invisible Hand'' to the cyborg general to use as a replacement flagship at the behest of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. Gunray's reluctance was assuaged by permission to allow [[Lushros Dofine/Legends|Lushros Dofine]] to be the captain of the ship, and he assigned [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] navigators and controllers to the bridge crew.''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'' The ''Invisible Hand'' saw action at many engagements including at [[Battle of Belderone|Belderone]], [[Bombardment of Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]], [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|Duro]], and the final [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Separatist strike]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. As part of [[Operation Durge's Lance]], Grievous oversaw numerous atrocities from the bridge of the ship, such as the deployment of the [[Brainrot Plague]] in the [[Weemell sector/Legends|Weemell sector]]. As the new flagship of the infamous General Grievous, slaughterer of billions, its name was so feared that Republic agents made a concerted effort to track the ship, but Grievous frequently swapped to a pair of "decoys", [[Lucid Voice/Legends|''Lucid Voice'']] and ''[[Colicoid Swarm]]'', for [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] patrols to confuse the enemy and further terrorize unsuspecting [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] worlds. [[File:Grievous_escape_pod.png|thumb|left|250px|Grievous abandons his flagship.]] It was aboard the ''Invisible Hand'' that [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was held captive and [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] lost his life to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. The Battle of Coruscant would be the ''Invisible Hand''{{'s}} last battle, however. Due to the suddenness of the attack, as well as heavy signal jamming, not all Republic forces were aware of the Chancellor's presence aboard the ''Invisible Hand'' and continued firing on it. A barrage of [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire from the ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer [[Guarlara (Venator-class)/Legends|''Guarlara'']] took the ''Invisible Hand'' down. Due to Captain Dofine's quick thinking: reversed stabilizers, magnetized fields; and General Grievous's last resort measure—the emergency booster engines—the ship was righted again, but not for long. During a skirmish on the bridge with Skywalker and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] the main viewport was shattered by Grievous in order to make his escape, sucking most of the crew into space. Dofine and what remained of the crew ran off the bridge, allowing the ''Invisible Hand'' to finally succumb to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] gravity, splitting in two as it fell out of orbit.
[[File:Handsplits.png|thumb|left|220px|The ''Invisible Hand'' splits in two.]]
Against all odds, Skywalker landed what was left of the ship in an abandoned industrial zone, knocking over a radar tower in the process. Though Skywalker, Kenobi, and Palpatine survived, the ship was reduced to a wreck. The [[Invisible Hand cantina]] on Coruscant was later named after it and had on display hull fragments were claimed to be from the ''Invisible Hand'' and had dropped on Coruscant following its destruction.{{DoD|A Reckoning of Wraiths}} ==Behind the scenes== The modified communication and sensor pod used by Dooku is referred to as the "[[Wizard's Tower/Legends|Wizard's Tower]]" in the ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''. Early concept sketches described the cruiser as being from the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|Banking Clan]] world of [[Mygeeto]], thus producing a number of art pieces with prominent crystalline structures.{{DB|starship|tradefederationcruiser|Trade Federation cruiser}} In [[2007]], a model of the ship was incorporated into the [[Topps]]/[[WizKids Games|WizKids]] game, ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]''. The ship was also made into a die cast model in the [[Hasbro]] Titanium series of miniature vehicles. The name was coined by [[Matthew Stover]] in his Legends [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|Revenge of the Sith novelization]], as the script given to him did not have a name. It has two meanings, the first being Palpatine's orchestration of the Clone Wars and the second being a jab at people who idolize Adam Smith's 'Invisible Hand' metaphor.''The HoloFiles'', [https://theholofiles.com/2025/10/13/11-things-we-learned-from-the-revenge-of-the-sith-novelization-deluxe-edition/ 11 Things We Learned from the ‘Revenge of the Sith’ Novelization Deluxe Edition] In the novelization, every single member of the bridge crew is killed, while the movie clearly shows some members fleeing to the escape pods shortly before Grievous and the members escape.
